passages.text: Zygopetalum maculatum is a species of orchid native to Peru, Bolivia and Brazil. The plants are mainly situated in flat, very wet, moss-covered, semi-boggy areas at elevations of {{convert|1100 to 2500|m|abbr=on}}.

Description
Zygopetalum maculatum has a {{convert|40|cm|abbr=on}} long inflorescence with eight to twelve fragrant flowers. The flowers are {{convert|4-8|cm|abbr=on}} wide, and are green with red-brown markings with a white lip marked with violet.
Successfully pollinated flowers close slightly to indicate pollination. Pollinated flowers remain healthy and colorful for up to three months, but unpollinated flowers wilt after one month.
